## Project Summary

Next.js (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4) web app for AI Makers
Academy, an online school for learning to build with AI. Modeled after edX's
layout (hero, course grid, catalog, course detail pages). Courses: AI Coding
for iPhone Apps, AI Coding for Android Apps, AI Coding for Web Applications,
AI Coding for Video Games, and AI Video Creation. See README.md for structure
and setup instructions.
